subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: The planner assigns values from the normative assessment vocabulary, cites evidence that substantively supports every recorded value, never emits a task-level `no_inference` mode, and never produces a semantic profile below deterministic policy floors.
intent: versioned clear-case and adversarial task corpus covering every accepted assessment/profile value, consequence floor, named promotion, planner raise, and mechanical-looking agent task; support rubric: every axis has explicit support in one or more cited anchors, one anchor may support multiple axes, and any contradiction or unsupported axis fails
fit_criterion: 100% structurally valid; 100% exact on unambiguous golden cases; zero unresolved, irrelevant, contradictory, or partially supporting citation sets; zero `no_inference` outputs; zero consequence/assurance under-floor outcomes
